name: openbot
description: A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration.
one_liner: A desktop app that gives you a 'team' of AI assistants, each with its own workspace and to-do list, that can hand work to each other and run on your own computer.
buyer: A solo founder or small agency owner running several AI-assisted projects at once who wants each one tracked separately instead of juggling one chat window per task.
business_use_cases: A one-person software shop runs a 'coding agent' and a 'QA agent' side by side on the same app, with one filing bugs the other then fixes overnight.
A content agency gives each client its own persistent agent workspace that remembers that client's style guide and prior work across sessions.
A technical consultant sets up delegated, crash-safe task queues so client requests keep processing even when they're away from the keyboard.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a managed, pre-configured 'agent team' setup service to small businesses who want this but can't install and wire it up themselves.
Offer ongoing agent-workspace administration and monitoring as a retainer for agencies running many client agents.

steal_this: Set up two agent workspaces this weekend — one that researches a niche and one that drafts outreach emails from the research — and sell the combo as a lead-gen service.
